answer: Rotation is entered in the pearl index and the meadow audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 191 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the lantern beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 12 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
